jobs.editPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit the supplied reaction illustration. Remove ONLY all milky white, gray and colored fog/haze/backdrop behind the gentleman and emoji bubbles. Preserve the complete gentleman, his pose and all three pale-blue emoji speech bubbles. Every region outside the exact silhouette of the man and each speech bubble must be truly transparent, including the gaps between the bubbles. Add generous transparent padding above the top bubble so no subject touches a canvas edge. Keep the bubbles as isolated crisp round opaque pale blue objects, not halos. No cast shadow, drop shadow, glow, haze, atmosphere, backdrop, rectangle, text, card, frame or numbers. Do not replace or recolor the subjects. Genuine alpha transparency, not a checkerboard pattern.
